en:
You came to practice again, right?
I'm glad you're serious about this.
Then, let's start.

Shuichi, I think this is a good place to stop
so let's end here for today.
Ah, done already?

Yeah, well... Whenever we see each other,
we play the piano together, right?
It feels like I'm forcing you to do this...
You're not having fun...are you, Shuichi?
No way! I'm having lots of fun!
R-Really?

Okay!
Then, let's do it again!

Since I told you my secret,
you're gonna have to tell me yours!

What!?
Why?

Because I've decided!
We're talking about you today!

<CLT=cltMIND>We are...?
Kaede's so pushy today...

Well, if you want me to...
But what should I talk about?
How about...your hobbies?
Hobbies? Um...

Huh!?
You have to *think* about your hobbies!?
W-Well...

<CLT=cltMIND>I remember helping out
with the detective business...

I suppose...being a detective
*is* my hobby.

Mmhm, I see.
Detective work is your hobby...

What, you're taking notes!?
Where did you get that notebook!?
From my backpack.
Ah, I see...

So your hobby is being a detective...
Then, we should enjoy being that today.
What?

I'm gonna be the detective who'll expose
your secret!

I thought *I* was going
to be the detective!

Being interrogated might be good experience!
It'll be useful next time you're in action!
Really!?

Yup! So now, next question!
What's your favorite food?
Meat? Veggies? Fish?
Juicy meat
Healthy vegetables
Fresh fish
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltMIND>Well, from those choices...
Juicy meat...

Hmm, that's a pretty typical boy answer.
Can you eat a giant steak in one sitting?
Ah, well...

Althooough, you don't look like you can eat
a lot of meat... But I shouldn't judge...
Healthy vegetables...

Vegetables?
Are you worried about your calorie intake?

A little bit...
I'm not athletic, I gain weight easily...

Hmmm, I see...
So you're that type...
Fresh fish...

Fish, huh? I prefer fish over meat, too!
We're so alike!
Y-Yeah...

Then, I guess I shouldn't worry about
our compatibility...
<CLT=cltMIND>What is she muttering about...?

Next question!
What's your favorite place?

That's a pretty broad question,
I don't know if I can answer that.

Oh, right.
Ummm...how about...
The movies
The amusement park
Whatever they pick
Are you unsure of something?

If you went out on like...a date...where would
you go? Movies or the amusement park?
The movies, I suppose.

Movies, huh? I see...
By the way, what's your favorite genre?

W-Well, I'll watch anything, but...
I can never get into love stories.
O-Oh, I see...

Well, it's a bit too fast to watch a romance
movie with just two people anyway!
The amusement park, I suppose.

Amusement park, huh?
You're pretty outgoing.

Ah, I get that a lot. But being a detective
is mostly about gathering information, so...

Mmhm.
I see.
Whatever they pick, I suppose.
Hmmm...that's gonna be a problem...
Huh? Why?

Nothing! It just means you're less likely
to make a move, right?
<CLT=cltMIND>...She's taking notes again.
What are you gonna use those notes for?
That's...
...Yes?
A secret!
What?

Don't worry, it won't be used for anything bad!
I won't show these notes to anyone else!

Detective Kaede Akamatsu is just gettin'
started! Tell me everything ya know, punk!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Kaede's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>After Kaede finished questioning me,
I returned to my room.
